scope: Consumed-data interactive development replay; no source generalization claim.
objective: Best paid, verified, correct whole-program speedup subject to measured area/timing and a fixed attempt budget.
prompt: Select one RISC-V custom instruction, or the unchanged baseline. Maximize VERIFIED FEASIBLE whole-program speedup within the measurement-attempt budget. Predictions are uncalibrated, not measurements. Consider all provided heuristics, structure, uncertainty, area, timing and measurement cost. Use only list_candidates, predict, measure and finalize. Every submitted measure request, including an invalid ID or repeat, consumes an attempt; failed measurements also count. No unqueried outcome is available. Only a paid, correct, device-fitting, area/timing-feasible improving candidate can be finalized. You may stop early. Provide a short decision summary, not private chain of thought. Single instructions only; individual speedups and area cannot be added. This is consumed-data replay, not fresh hardware measurement or an unseen-workload experiment.

tools.name: list_candidates
tools.description: List public candidates and selection constraints.

tools.name: predict
tools.description: Query fixed predictors for candidate IDs.

tools.name: measure
tools.description: Pay for one candidate measurement, including failures.

tools.name: finalize
tools.description: Choose one verified feasible candidate or baseline (null).

historical_cost_note: Archived attempt costs retain original timer scopes; no project-time savings are inferred.
chat_boundary: The request/output channel contains allowlisted JSON; the active Codex session itself also has broader workspace tools.
